newsitem.title: USA: Interface sees new CEO by early next year.
newsitem.headline: Interface sees new CEO by early next year.

text.p: Interface Systems Inc said Monday it expects to select a new chief executive officer by the end of the first quarter or beginning of the second quarter in fiscal 1997.
The company Monday reported a loss of $0.23 a share for the fiscal fourth quarter that ended Septebmer 30, up from a loss of $0.13 in the year-ago period.
Interface, which makes document management and presentation products for computer systems, attributed its lower results to slower than expected revenues from its core products and Oasis product line.
It also blamed increased operating expenses to support its new Oasis product line, and expenses associated with its management transition.
Interface said it expects improved printer revenues in fiscal 1997, as well as higher revenues and margins from its distribution business in fiscal 1997.
